• ¹When used in Scalp protect mode

Operating Instructions: 1. Start with hair that is completely dried and detangled before using Le Pirouette. 2. The lights on the tool will each flash once when it is first/initially plugged into the electrical outlet (the tool has not started heating). 3. To heat Le Pirouette, press the button for 3 seconds and a white light will blink above the default temperature of 330 degrees F until it reaches temperature. 4. To select a different temperature, quickly press and release the button until the light next to your desired temperature begins blinking. 5. Once the tool has reached temperature, the white light will become solid above its current temperature. 6. Apply your L'ange heat protectant of choice. 7. Press the thumb rest to open the clip. 8. Starting 1-2 inches from your ends, insert a 0.5-1 inch section of hair (for best results, insert hair into the middle of the clamp). 9. Press the or button to auto rotate the barrel in your preferred direction. 10. Once the strand is wrapped, hold for approximately 5-10 seconds. 11. Press the thumb rest to allow the curl to slide out from around the barrel. 12. Allow the curl to cool in the palm of your hand. 13. Press the circular home button to return the clamp back to center. 14. Repeat all over until the desired style is achieved. 15. Apply your finishing spray of choice and tousle to separate. 16. Once you're finished styling, press and hold button for 3 seconds to turn tool off. All lights will turn off. 17. Unplug Le Pirouette and wait until completely cooled before storing away.

The Nue Co. Otherwhere Nostalgia is the now, shaped by everything before. Smells like skin — but better. Unlike anything you’ve smelt before. Notes of Caramel, Gentle Oud, Sandalwood, Cardamom, and Incense create a fragrance reminiscent of the past, but grounded in the present. 

Features

• Nostalgia is more than a feeling. It’s a physiological response that calms the nervous system and grounds the mind. When you smell something familiar, the olfactory system sends a direct signal to the limbic brain, the center of memory and emotion.
• It’s why scent can unlock vivid memories in an instant, often tied to moments of safety and warmth.
• Research from Brown University found that the scents we experience as newborns hold the strongest power of emotional recall. These early scent memories are imprinted in the brain, forming a blueprint for comfort that lasts a lifetime.
• We are naturally drawn to gourmand notes like vanilla and tonka bean because they share compounds found in milk and childhood sweets. They remind the body of when things were simple, good, and safe.
• In one study, patients exposed to gourmand scents during MRI scans reported 63% less anxiety compared to those exposed to neutral scents (PubMed, 1994).
• Another study showed these same notes can activate the brain’s reward centre, triggering the release of dopamine, the neurotransmitter linked to pleasure and calm (PMC5742189).
• This is the science behind The Nostalgia Collection. Each scent is designed to work with the body’s chemistry to reawaken comfort, release tension, and restore emotional balance: a way back to yourself, through scent.
• Unlike anything you’ve smelled before; it’s familiar yet ethereal, grounding and comforting. Blending notes of Green Cardamom, Almond Blossom and Caramel with the deep complex notes of Alaskan Cedar, Incense and Oud.

Fragrance Family

• Gourmand, Woods, Smoke

Features

• Green Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Juniper Berry
• Almond Blossom, Strawberry Leaves, Violet, Caramel
• Alaskan Cedar, Sandalwood, Olibanum Incense, Myrrh, Oud

sections.bodyString:
The Nue Co. Functional Fragrance De-Stress is your anti-stress fragrance supplement with calming green cardamom and cilantro. 

Features

• Cognitive function and the olfactory system are connected. Developed over five years with The University of Geneva and created by renowned perfumer Frank Voelkl, Functional Fragrance is a pioneering anti-stress supplement in fragrance form.
• Using data from the Geneva Emotion & Odour Study (GEOS) and neural imaging insights, it’s formulated to positively impact both mind and body, helping you feel centered and at ease.

Features

• Valentino Donna Born in Roma Yellow Dream Eau de Parfum is a fresh, citrus, floral perfume for women that paints a scented picture of Rome: a romantic golden light clashes with a neon attitude.
• A bright women's perfume of a thousand rose petals, Donna Yellow Dream twists Italian Lemon, Damascan Rose, and sensual White Musk to create a vivid and luminous women's fragrance that captivates with a neon yellow signature.
• The Born in Roma creation started with a dialogue with Valentino's native city: Rome. The streets of Rome are filled with memories of the past. A symbol of free thought, Rome is a city where cultures and aesthetics layer on the walls. Reverence and irreverence collide.
• Born in Roma pays a tribute to both haute couture and street culture that coexists in Maison Valentino designs. It is about an attitude towards life: I claim my heritage and I create my own rules.
• About the Bottle: Enchased with edginess, the perfume bottle is designed with the iconic Valentino rockstud: inspired by Roman architecture, this small pyramidal shape transforms a bottle from classic to edgy. The bottle is multi-facetted and energized by a yellow fluo signature.
• ''Dream is the language of the soul.'' - Pierpaolo Piccioli, Maison Valentino Creative Director

Fragrance Family

The Nue Co. Water Therapy De-Stress is a relaxing fragrance with marine scent notes, inspired by blue medicine. Water Therapy is like swimming through fresh water, filled with seaweed and rose petals. A heart of fig rounds the aquatic notes grounded by a smooth sandalwood finish. 

Features

• Inspired by the concept of blue medicine, the idea that water positively affects our mood and can support in regulating our central nervous system, this fragrance is rooted in the practice of thalassotherapy (seawater therapy).
• It uses patented fragrance technology to mimic the calming effect of being in, near or under water.
• Crafted by renowned perfumer Linda Song, this sensory supplement blends sandalwood, seaweed, clary sage, rose, cardamom, and fir with notes of marine salt and amber. The result is a fresh, crisp fragrance with warm, woodsy undertones, complemented by the delicate floral touch of rose.
• Sourced sustainably through community-centered projects, Water Therapy is more than a scent; it’s a journey to a place of calm, inspired by the power of water.

Fragrance Family

• Aromatic, Floral, Salty, Warm Spicy

Features

• Seaweed, Bergamot
• Fig, Rose
• Vetiver, Sandalwood, Salt
